reason: 该插件的核心用途是优化 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话界面的工具调用展示：按回合聚合 tool-call 日志并以折叠摘要卡片替代原始逐行刷屏输出。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 的会话界面中按回合聚合工具调用，并以可折叠分组展示摘要和状态，支持展开查看单条调用详情。
summaries.en: This plugin groups tool calls by conversation turn in the DeepSeek Harness web chat UI, showing a collapsed summary card per turn with expandable rows for individual call details.

capabilities: Consolidates tool-call messages per conversation turn into grouped UI entries in the chat stream
Shows per-turn summary metadata such as total, in-progress, and failed call counts
Provides expandable tool-call rows with truncated output and single-line summaries
Supports optional hiding/showing of read-only tool calls
Falls back to built-in rendering if custom tool-call rendering fails

reasons.code: README describes collapsing each turn's tool calls into one collapsible group with a summary card to reduce chat stream clutter.
README states read-only calls (read/grep/glob/web_search) can be hidden by default with a toggle and preference stored in localStorage.
package.json declares a DSH web client plugin with UI tool runtime dependencies, indicating behavior is implemented in the web conversation interface.
